issues.failure_explanation: The proof's function phi(z) = <grad g(z^k), z> + (L_k/2)||z - z^k||^2 excludes q, so the exact expansion is phi(y^k) - phi(z^{k+1}) = <grad g(z^k), y^k - z^{k+1}> + (L_k/2)(||y^k - z^k||^2 - ||z^{k+1} - z^k||^2); the displayed bound replaces the quadratic difference by (L_k/2)||y^k - z^{k+1}||^2 and inserts a q-difference, which is valid only if L_k<y^k - z^{k+1}, z^k - z^{k+1}> <= q(z^{k+1}) - q(y^k). This fails, e.g., for g(z) = -z (0-smooth), q = delta_{[-1,3]}, c = -1 (L_c = 1), z^k = 0, L_k = 1: the subproblem solution is z^{k+1} = 1, the Slater point y^k = 1.1 satisfies c-bar(y^k, z^k) = -0.395 < 0, and phi(y^k) - phi(z^{k+1}) = 0.095 while the claimed right-hand side is -0.2 + 0.02 + 0 = -0.18. (Also, the Lagrangian L-tilde used for 'z^{k+1} = argmin L-tilde(., lambda^k)' omits q, inconsistent with the KKT system (thm2_KKT_Stationary) that includes partial q.) The final constant A is nevertheless correct: dropping the nonpositive term gives zeta^{-1}(G D_Y + (L-bar/2)D_Y^2 + M_q).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the displayed step by the exact expansion phi(y^k) - phi(z^{k+1}) = <grad g(z^k), y^k - z^{k+1}> + (L_k/2)(||y^k - z^k||^2 - ||z^{k+1} - z^k||^2) (adding the q-difference), bound it by ||grad g(z^k)|| D_Y + (L-bar/2) D_Y^2 + M_q, and keep the definition of A unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: Only the written proof of Lemma lambda-bound is unsound; the stated bound and its later uses (constant omega in Lemma distBound / Theorem sub_iters, and the outer oracle counts) remain valid after the step is repaired.
issues.title: False intermediate inequality in the proof of Lemma lambda-bound

issues.failure_explanation: The identity is false for the paper's own definitions: take the proper closed function phi(u) = |u| on R and u-bar = 0. Then partial phi(0) = [-1,1], so dist(0, partial phi(0)) = 0, while |grad phi|(z) = 1 for every z != 0, whence overline{|grad phi|}(0) = liminf_{z->0}|grad phi|(z) = 1 != 0. The proof of Lemma lem:QG_pot chains two false links -- '|grad phi_x|(y-bar,z-bar) >= overline{|grad phi_x|}(y-bar,z-bar)' and the equality of item (i) -- to obtain |grad phi_x|(y-bar,z-bar) >= dist(0, partial phi_x(y-bar,z-bar)); both links fail in general (slopes can drop at a kink, and the limiting slope need not equal the subdifferential distance). The needed inequality dist(0, partial phi(u-bar)) <= |grad phi|(u-bar) is nevertheless true (a short Ekeland/fuzzy-sum-rule argument, consistent with the cited reference's actual statement), so the growth and error-bound conclusions remain true but are not established by the given proof.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace item (i) by the true one-sided relation dist(0, partial phi(u-bar)) <= |grad phi|(u-bar) (a short Ekeland variational-principle argument, which is what the cited literature supports) and, in Lemma lem:QG_pot's proof, use it directly instead of the two invalid links; all subsequent displays and theorems then go through unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The supporting Lemma errbnd(i) is false as stated, so the proofs of Lemma lem:QG_pot and, through it, Lemma lem:EB_pot, Lemma lem:PhiOver_localHolder, Theorems thm:Phi_localHolder and thm:Phi_QG, and (transitively) the sketched proofs of the complexity results are unsound as written; the statements themselves remain true under the corrected slope inequality.
issues.title: Lemma errbnd(i) states a false equality between limiting slope and subdifferential distance
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local, standard correction (restate the misquoted identity as the true inequality and drop the spurious 'slope >= limiting slope' step); every substantive conclusion, rate, and downstream result is preserved with no new construction, so the issue is minor.
